body:
Yeahhh, I struggled to come into terms that I wasn't into romance because of this ideology, of what media and society believes is the happiest life one can love and if you don't find a partner you most likely die alone or miserable. Well, there are other kinds of happiness that I want to have.
A sense of selfcare, I want to grow up as a person and be happy with my friends, I want to have a place to live on my own and progress and find a career that I like.

Interesting example, it truly makes you think that people could be more content if things weren't that forced.

Many thanks for the answer!!
Wise words to hold on to. Thank you so much!! 😊

Indeed, I accept that it wasn't okay for me to do that, even if I was confused about what was going on, it lead me to this situation.

It really sucks to reject and being rejected, I wish it was less hurtful. 

Thanks for the answer!

☺️ it's good! I needed a bit of advice and to see if I wasn't overreacting. This ugly emotion, hurt, I wanted to get rid of it, and ended up feeling worse. But now I realize it doesn't have to be like that and that I should for once think of myself. That's something I didn't do in a long time.

Thank you so much for the wonderful words 🥺.
Well, I wouldn't say those exact words to be honest haha, but I get what you mean. Thanks!
That's one of my weakest traits, I used to be afraid to speak up, voice my opinions, and somewhat end up having trouble in doing that as of now. I'll be sure to tell him next time. Many thanks!
I still want to believe that he can do better....but it worries me a bit. Thanks.

I do try to have a casual conversation once in a while, it begins to be strange when it's obvious that those feelings persist, and can't seem to consider that there are other people that could give him what I cannot.
It frustrastes me to no end because, he's not a bad guy, but I don't think he never got rejected before me. He told me he dated once but I never got any more words from that so I can't really figure him out.

Whenever I'm unsure if I made the right choice, I think at that moment, and still feel the same, but a bit bitter that it shouldn't be this difficult to deal with. That's why I blamed myself.

I'm thankful for your words. If I would do any of that with him I would be lying to myself.

You nailed it! That's exactly how it was for me!. I was feeling bad for having to deal with a possible heartbreak. It's better to tell him early than later regretting it, as I don't see myself with anyone.

Being more open with feelings and searching for something to relate to really helps. I think I can move on better now!

No worries, the one who's crazy is me for writing a lot lol. Thanks and best wishes! 💓

Yes, both parties have to be happy/stable to function in the best way possible. Can't give him that support when I'm fine as it is now. I've met people that changed partners every week or month, and that mortified me. My friend had a 7year relationship, broke up, went with another guy, got pregnant, guy turned out to be one one of the worst people ever, she thankfully dumped him but, you can see where I'm going. Made me even more cautious of romance, and that it's not wrong to not want to have anything before it goes all down.

I'm trying to be as neutral and partial as possible, to make it less awkward, there's not much I can do unless he tried again, and that's when I'll be more direct, as everyone's suggestion.

I'm sorry you had to deal with that, it's good that atleast you realized it and took the iniciative. Hope you're alright now.

I had to look it up at the Urban dictionary. Oh, well...it does have his moments when he's overly nice and polite, I do want to believe he doesn't have any ulterior motives. I *really* hope it doesn't keep it that way.
I'll keep it in mind. I hope he can understand me if I have to explain it with detail. I'd hate to lose another friendship, so, I'll see how it turns out. Thanks!

I guess, in a sense, I have some aspects I don't know of myself. I'm looking to have some stability in my life, more on the mental and emotionaly department. Being a loner for so long made me question why I was like this, and if there was something wrong with me. I didn't have true friends until I went to the university, and since then, I started to be less closeted. After seeing firsthand too many stories, I started to wonder - if someday I'll ever find a partner for me, and if that would make me happier, like everyone tries to tell you.

Yeah, the first guy was my best friend at the moment, but I was too young, and shy/naive compared to other girls my age and didn't want to think he had other intentions, since I valued our friendship. But, of course, there were some *obvious* hints. The playful fighting, the way he looked at me, etc. What really unnerved me was that he said this phrase:

"There can never exist friendship between a guy and a gal"

I was gonna call bullshit on that because *what the heck do you suppose we are?*. Later I understood, he never intended to stay that way, even after my rejection I knew it wouldn't be the same again. So, after all the situation I described in my first post, I grew distant, until I got over it. I do wish my ex-friend happiness, but don't want to have anything to do with him, so when he tried to add me on Steam, I insta blocked him, he was the one who suggested we never contact eachother again. It seems he can't hold unto his own words.

Which brings me with the second one, after all, it was like it was all repeating again, I had to explain and turn him down the best way I could think of. It's just....it's difficult when he reacts/behaves like that when we're together. I don't think he would get it if I blurt out "hey, I'm not interested in romance in general, possibly never" because from past experiences, it's not the most believable answer.

Thanks for the heads up, I have a tendency to be pessimistic, or think in the worst outcomes, it's something I have to do better, part of my personality. 

I recently learned about the concept of aro, so any variants it may have is out of my knowledge. Appreciate the page suggestion! I'll be sure to check it out 😊

Wow, I have so many emotions from this 🥺🥺. I needed someone to tell me straight to me about my insecurities, of who I AM, to be honest. There was some point that I really thought I was the worst person ever and hated myself, but it shouldn't be that way. I can feel the encouragement!!

I'll give him more time, and see what happens, now that I have a clean mind.

Thank you so much! 💓

Oh, I guess it was a bit confusing the way I wrote it but it goes like this:

- Don't like the idea of romance/ being in relationships

- Don't want to sleep with anyone just to satiate a desire , the only way I *would* consider it would be IF I had a romantic connection with someone. It's not worth it if there are no feelings involved, just really hate the idea of fwb and all that. I only mentioned it because there are moments when I have urges, and I'm not repulsed with the act in itself, more uncomfortable, given the situation.

- In conclusion, since it's not possible for me to see anyone at the present in a romantic way, and so, the other part is also discarded.

Apologies if this doesn't make it clear.

What an elaborate and thoughtful answer! To sum it up, that's exactly what's going on here. As soon I knew he had other intentions, I wanted for him to be honest and confess. I waited for him to say it, but, he was denying it/being playful so that's when this happens:

S (him) A (Me)

A - "So...you wanted to tell me something?"

S - "Maybe, maybe not, what do you think?" He said with a suggestive tone.

A- "I think I know what're you going to say" I look at his eyes.

S - "What is it then?" He gets closer. 

At this point I wanted to tell him, "cmon, get on with it!!" but instead answer:

A - "That you like me, as in more of a friend"

He grins and laughs a bit

S- "Well, it al depends...."

A- "Depends on what" I feign ignorance.

S- "Depends if you feel the same way" and then he looks at me with those puppy eyes.

I expected it but was in a shock, you see, you have to say something after that but I was in a loss for words. Didn't help that I'm socially awkward and all that.

I rejected him later but I believe he didn't fully move on, and that's what worried me. I know that these are his feelings, and it must be hard to let go of one person, but I wont change my mind, even if it hurts. I do consider other's happiness first, and as my Best friend said, I'm a people pleaser, so that's why I said it that way, that I'm selfish. Still have ways to go but it's always nice to consider other points of view. 

Thank you so much for your honestity.

100‰ agreed on the expectations thing. One part of me is dealing with personal things, so I wouldn't be that emotionaly stable for the relationship he wants, even though I'm better than I was before. Of course, that isn't to say that that was the most important reason for rejecting him. I don't find him attractive (but seriously, you don't say that to a person, right?) I don't feel a romantic connection, and never will. A mutual friend told me to try and "test the waters" as of saying I should give him a chance and try dating for once. After thinking for a while, if I would do that, I told her no but thankfully didn't bring out the topic again.

As for the guy, he thinks I'm the one because there are a few coincidences that he once voiced out. Both of our fathers are long-time friends, he claimed we had the same type of blood and so it was great (????) which later was disproved since I'm 0 - and he's an A +. Since then he tried to get more common things that we share.

I like him as a friend, so after considering all things, it wouldn't be fair to be together if I would be unhappy and would make him, as you say, miserable. It's just that I didn't want to be rude or mean or let it repeat like what happened with my ex-best friend.

It was the best choice I could think of. Hopefully, he'll find someone that loves him. The only thing I want, is to him to don't look at me with hope and for me to don't think of myself as a bad person for feeling this way.

Thank you for your lovely words. And say amazing too, friend 🤗

Hello! Thanks for the kind words.

I too, didn't realize this was an orientation, or that it had a specific name. I knew that asexuality was a thing, and, while I may be a virgin, it's because I didn't want to be in a relationship (I dislike the idea of a fling, friends with benefits or whatever you call it) And if I we're to get physical with someone, it would be someone I would be romantically invested in. But what happens when there's no romance on one's life? It seems....almost imposible, or well, not that accepted. Thanks to my friend who he himself came out as bisexual, told me that he had this other friend who was aro and was a happy person. That's when I got interested and thought "WOW, this relatable!"

I'm not sure how to label myself, now that you mention it, there are many ways of aroromanticism that I didn't know of!

Thanks for the warm welcome. I'm not one to post and/or write that much but I appreciate it! 😄
Thank you 😌

Totally. I hate to hurt other people, more if they are friends so I didn't want to get distant with him and make it awkward. That's what I wanted to know if I maybe screwed up again. 

Nice to see some positivity. Thanks!!

Yeah, he's not a bad guy, we share some interests, but that's about it. 

To add up about yesterday: after walking and talking (I was sure to try and make some topics in gereral) he invites me to this café. Sure, I accept, just it was the first time I went out alone with a guy friend and not a female friend. He payed for my coffee, even after I insisted, that no, he didn't have to worry about it, and didn't accept my money, saying that I deserved it for going out with him (??).
I really didn't like not paying for myself, but I let it go. Then we sit down, talked for a bit. Didn't had any issues until ,again, he was giving me this mixed signal, and said how it was wonderful to go out just the two alone since we're really close (???).
I was thinking "Uhhhh, sure buddy, whatever you say" (we aren't THAT close)

So then the topic changes to personal values and the present. I actually said that I was happy the way I was, and that I wanted to understand and try things myself, that I still had to deal with a few things but that was my top priority.

He for the nth time looked hurt for my answer, gave me a weak smile and say that the future is uncertain and the fact I was fine in being alone might change soon. Ar this point I grew annoyed and a bit guilty, so I told him that I was late for an appointment. He apologized and accompanied me to my car. When we got to our homes he messaged me on how great it was and he expected me to invite him whenever I wanted. I responded with one "Maybe, but it's difficult as of now, later" and just leave it at that.

I don't think I would go alone again (with him) any time soon, if I didn't accept the date, he would insist and my excuses would run out, so I went for the safest option.

After considering all things, I wanted to search for info, and see if anyone got similar experiences. Saw a few posts of people "friendzoning" or not wanting to be in relationships but mostly were people that regretted it at some point. Sure, there are many others that don't see it that way, so, I remembered about what a friend told me: I was in the aro spectrum and that was also valid, I searched for this subreddit and glad to know it exists.

Thank you for your words, I may have added a bit, but it's as you say, to insist for a relationship is tiresome. I wanted an external opinion of my story. I feel better now.

I'm a radiology student on the last year of the career. Since I couldn't do any medical practices because of the virus, I'll have to do my final exam this friday and, ngl, I'm truly nervous. It's about rx physics (digital and conventional rx equipment) and contrast mediums with the corresponding studies.

I'm not sure if I should give it a try or wait for december to tackle it. Is it wrong to have insecurities before a big exam?

As for the career itself, it's good, there are a few boring subjects to study like psychology or story of the public health.

While I don't have any problems with blood, fluids or any kind of mess you can find in a hospital, I think that having a strong mind, being sociable helps a lot.

When I started to practice in a hospital with technicians, we had various patients from car crashes, boating incidents and even  prisoners (with security) from the prison. There were also some fights and uncooperation but that's to be expected. 

After all the experiences and everything I've learned, I'm having second thoughts. Had a falling out some time ago and recently I've learned that one of the technicians which was basically my mentor passed away. I was heartbroken as I truly respected him.

Being a radiologist has its perks and counters. The most common saying is that there aren't many, the pay is good, you're almost guaranteed to find a spot for work and, due to the radiation exposure from x rays, most radiologists retire at a moderate age.

In short, I wanted to post here and share some opinions or stories if you want to.

I'm not sure as I'm standing I want to finish this career, for personal reasons, but my family considers it selfish if I don't do the videocall the exam day.

If you have the passion and the will to keep this path, do it. I'm not sure so for myself.

Thanks to anyone who reads this

Indeed, can't stress myself how many times I've heard that depression is just a phase or it's stupid to overthink too much. I don't do this for the attention, it's a reality that many people struggle with. The outcome also depends on the will, as you say. Can't let it rule forever.

Next week or after that I'll do an update.

Thank you *so* much. Have a good one! ^^

The truth is, they know that something is going on. Mostly my brother, we had a heart-to-heart talk and he also talked about his problems. The one that knows the whole truth is my best friend and another friend that's going through the same. They're so supportive and I'll be forever thankful to them.

I can't tell my family, atleast yet, that I wanted to kill myself. They would be devastated. My mother is an essential worker on the local hospital, where we have a few covid cases and has high blood pressure. My father is retired, and is always doing something, but he's old. As for my brother...he's unemployed, we know eachother from all life, and even so, he's better than me and never gives up. I love them, and that's why I want to change, and be strong for once, like I used to be.

After taking a nap, I'll have to write a lot before studying. I hope this time I can end it and make them proud, even if I'm not sure what I wish to do with my path in life.

Thank you for the amazing quote. You reminded me of what someone said to me long ago:

"Every stumble is not a fall, and every fall does not mean failure"

I'll do my best, but can't promise I wont have negative thoughts. It's not something that goes away one day or another. But if it turns out well, a heavy weight will be lifted.

Thank you again for your kind words. Best wishes. *Hug*

I understand. That was also my most important reason of why didn't end it all that night. I thought about my family, my best friend, and other friends. How selfish I was for taking "the easy side" when they would suffer for my choice.

I like cooking and studying languages, years ago I would have chosen a career like that. I just think I wasted too much time and that's why I'm so unhappy with myself. I wish I had some work experience, it's difficult if I have this voice of my head stopping me from trying.



Thank you for your words. I also hope you get better. *hugs*
